6036.notes: Primary: FY6/2026 kessan tanshin (non-consolidated, JGAAP) and Q3 tanshin on TDnet. ALL EPS VALUES HERE ARE PRE-SPLIT (the tanshin predates the 1:2 split; record date 31 Oct 2026, announced 15 Sep 2026 per Matsui Securities news and the Japan IR disclosure list; the company's own split notice PDF was NOT opened). FY EPS 360.20 vs 179.14 (+101.1%); net profit 9,830 vs 4,888. Q4 standalone is derived: EPS 360.20 - 279.64 = 80.56 vs 179.14 - 134.11 = 45.03 (+78.9%); net profit 2,199 vs 1,228; operating profit 2,635 vs 1,728 (+52%); Q4 tax charge was low (459 on pre-tax 2,657, 17%). The securities gain was booked in Q2-Q3 (6,763 by nine months, 6,792 full year). 9M operating profit was -20.3%. Guidance: net profit 6,222 (-36.7%), EPS 227.98 pre-split; H1 forecast net profit 3,485 (-51.8%). The guidance fall reflects the missing one-off gain; if the main session prefers to exclude it as unrepresentative, the alternative business measure is operating profit: FY26 -2.6% actual, FY27 guidance +30.3%. I did NOT enter the company's 'excluding growth investment costs' figures (OP 8,007 +12.8%, net profit 5,567 +13.9%) as 'adjusted': they strip out ordinary marketing and staff costs. Q1 FY6/2027 (Jul-Sep 2026) results: searched, not found as of 14 Nov 2026 (last year they came on 14 Nov). Dividend: source has no yield; FY6/2027 forecast is 100 yen pre-split in the tanshin; 50 yen post-split is my arithmetic (the 15 Sep notice 'stock split ... and revision of dividend forecast' was not opened, so confirm). At 1,775 yen that is 2.8%.
